annotations.title: Send a message to the owner

description: Send a guest's enquiry to the site owner by email; the owner replies to the guest directly. Suited to sold-out dates, questions the listing details leave open, and request-to-book sites. Requires the guest's name, email address and message.

checkinDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD the enquiry is about.

destinationId.description: The site the enquiry is about.

guestEmail.description: The guest's email, so the owner can reply. Must be a real address the guest gave you.

guestName.description: The guest's name, as they gave it.

message.description: The enquiry in the guest’s words — dates, party, and the specific question.

phone.description: Optional phone number, only if the guest offered it.

name: message_owner
title: Send a message to the owner
